notes.notes:

[*]Fixed: issue with a random encounter
[*]Fixed: last mission not available

[/list]

notes.title: Caravan Update - v1.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o6Zt3vvGp2WwajNzW.gif[/img]

Solved issues in version 1.1:

- Several text fixes
- Experience for the quest „Travel preparation“ 
- The text of “Iram city of the pillars” is within the border
- The belated groom has skills now
- The price development of goods will be displayed only in cities with merchants
- The camera controls of the world map have been improved
- The mercenary skill “preparation” functions as intentionally 
- Various balancing updates

notes.title: Travel The Orient In Daedalic Entertainment s Caravan
notes.notes:
I was immediately intrigued by It Matters Games’ Caravan [official site], a simulator that took me back immediately to the days of puttering about in my elementary school computer lab. I fought valiantly for Kid Pix and The Oregon Trail encased in their felt floppy sleeves, and when I won The Oregon Trail that basically cinched the rest of the day for me. Caravan, so far as I can tell, wants to take me back to those simpler times, leaving me free to roam the Orient and the Arabian peninsula, trading and exploring.

… [visit site to read more]
